title: ExecutionPlanPayload
description: Canonical schema for machine-executable execution plans generated by the Planner Agent

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the task or issue

feature_name.description: Slug or kebab-case name of the feature

reqspec_triage.description: RULE-PLAN-006: planner decision whether /req-to-reqspec is required before planning. Fail-safe: when uncertain, REQUIRED.

decision.description: SKIP = TRD serves dual duty as requirements spec (single context, FR/AC complete); REQUIRED = decompose PRD into docs/reqspecs/ first

bounded_contexts.description: Bounded contexts / top-level modules identified in the input

reasons.description: Evidence-based justification for the decision (shown at Human Gate 2 for veto)

verification_commands.description: Global verification commands to run across the entire workspace

name.description: Concise human-readable title of the subtask

domain.description: Bounded context or functional topic this subtask belongs to (RULE-PLAN-007 Single Responsibility Invariant)

pr_group.description: Identifier of the target Pull Request grouping (e.g. PR-01, PR-AUTH-01) obeying RULE-PLAN-007

layer.description: Clean Architecture layer targeted by this subtask

estimated_loc.description: Estimated lines of code (RULE-PLAN-004 hard limit <= 500 LOC per PR/subtask)

depends_on.description: Prerequisite subtask IDs in the execution DAG

test_cases.description: List of TC-xx scenarios satisfied by this subtask

target_files.description: Whitelist of files this subtask is permitted to touch

verification_command.description: Targeted test/verification command for this subtask
